summary: This is a routine 8-K filing by Bain Capital Private Credit, a business development company, reporting a regular monthly distribution for Class I shares, NAV as of April 30, 2026, a portfolio update, and shares issued. The filing declares a $0.1875 per share distribution payable on June 30, 2026, with no premium, acquisition, or strategic event. No board recommendation, advisor, or structural changes are mentioned; it is a standard periodic disclosure. There is no special situation, as this mirrors a routine post-effective update or periodic report, not a merger, tender, or restructuring event.
